japanese: すみません、国際線の出発ロビーはどこですか？
reading: すみません、こくさいせんのしゅっぱつロビーはどこですか？
romaji: sumimasen, kokusaisen no shuppatsu robii wa doko desu ka?
english: Excuse me, where is the international departures lobby?
literalMeaning: Excuse me, where is the international flight departure lobby?
naturalUsage: Useful when you need help finding the correct departure area.

japanese: この便のチェックインカウンターはどこですか？
reading: このびんのチェックインカウンターはどこですか？
romaji: kono bin no chekkuin kauntaa wa doko desu ka?
english: Where is the check-in counter for this flight?
literalMeaning: Where is the check-in counter for this flight?
naturalUsage: Show your booking while asking if the flight number is easier than explaining it.

japanese: 預け荷物はこれ一つです。
reading: あずけにもつはこれひとつです。
romaji: azuke nimotsu wa kore hitotsu desu.
english: This is my only checked bag.
literalMeaning: The baggage to check is this one item.
naturalUsage: Natural at an airline counter when checking one bag.

japanese: 荷物の重さを確認してもいいですか？
reading: にもつのおもさをかくにんしてもいいですか？
romaji: nimotsu no omosa o kakunin shite mo ii desu ka?
english: May I check the weight of my luggage?
literalMeaning: Is it okay to confirm the luggage weight?
naturalUsage: Useful when you want to confirm baggage weight before finalizing check-in.

japanese: これは機内に持ち込めますか？
reading: これはきないにもちこめますか？
romaji: kore wa kinai ni mochikomemasu ka?
english: Can I bring this into the cabin?
literalMeaning: Can this be carried into the aircraft?
naturalUsage: Use for an item you are unsure is allowed in carry-on baggage.

japanese: これは出したほうがいいですか？
reading: これはだしたほうがいいですか？
romaji: kore wa dashita hou ga ii desu ka?
literalMeaning: Would it be better to take this out?
naturalUsage: Useful at security for laptops, liquids, batteries, or other items.
A concise answer if asked the purpose of your visit.

reading: ようかかんたいざいします。
literalMeaning: I will stay for eight days.
naturalUsage: Change the number of days as needed when answering immigration questions.

japanese: こちらがホテルの予約確認書です。
reading: こちらがホテルのよやくかくにんしょです。
romaji: kochira ga hoteru no yoyaku kakuninsho desu.
english: Here is my hotel booking confirmation.
literalMeaning: This is the hotel reservation confirmation.

reading: にもつがでてきません。
literalMeaning: My baggage is not coming out.
naturalUsage: Use at baggage claim when your checked bag does not arrive on the carousel.

japanese: この荷物が壊れていました。
reading: このにもつがこわれていました。
naturalUsage: Use at an airline baggage service counter for damage discovered after arrival.

japanese: 成田エクスプレスの乗り場はどこですか？
reading: なりたエクスプレスののりばはどこですか？
romaji: Narita Ekusupuresu no noriba wa doko desu ka?
english: Where is the Narita Express platform?
literalMeaning: Where is the boarding place for the Narita Express?
naturalUsage: Useful at Narita Airport when transferring to N’EX.

japanese: この切符で新宿まで行けますか？
reading: このきっぷでしんじゅくまでいけますか？
romaji: kono kippu de Shinjuku made ikemasu ka?
english: Can I get to Shinjuku with this ticket?
literalMeaning: Can I go as far as Shinjuku with this ticket?
naturalUsage: A useful confirmation when holding an airport rail ticket.

japanese: 搭乗口が変更になりましたか？
reading: とうじょうぐちがへんこうになりましたか？
romaji: toujouguchi ga henkou ni narimashita ka?
literalMeaning: Did the boarding gate become changed?
naturalUsage: Use when the display or announcement seems different from your boarding pass.

japanese: 搭乗は何時からですか？
reading: とうじょうはなんじからですか？
romaji: toujou wa nanji kara desu ka?
naturalUsage: Useful when the gate is open but boarding time is unclear.

japanese: すみません、英語で説明していただけますか？
reading: すみません、えいごでせつめいしていただけますか？
romaji: sumimasen, eigo de setsumei shite itadakemasu ka?
english: Excuse me, could you explain it in English?
literalMeaning: Could you please explain in English?
naturalUsage: A polite fallback if an airport procedure is difficult to understand.
